entities.name: Post-Emancipation Sugar Decline
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Both islands experienced severe economic decline as sugar prices fell due to competition from beet sugar and larger producers. The planter class maintained social control but faced mounting debts. Workers endured poverty and limited political rights under the Crown Colony system.
